sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online, Melee, Topdeck)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 14 days since it was played. Magic Online: 101 tournaments, 1679 lists from Challenges and other events, 560 from leagues; Melee: 28 tournaments, 3613 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues; Topdeck: 2 tournaments, 1 lists from Challenges and other events, 3 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder. 1 of 5856 lists left out for cards Standard does not allow: Akroma's Vengeance (1), Aura of Silence (1), Barren Moor (1), Caves of Koilos (1), Decree of Justice (1).
